name: demo-spike-30
comment: Descriptive input. This is the ONLY thing a user edits. Everything downstream is generated.

gas.comment: Ratio of specific heats. 1.20 is a common placeholder for hot combustion products. For a cold-gas or air demonstrator use 1.40.

nozzle.comment: truncate_fraction 1.0 is the ideal full spike. Real engines truncate hard; 0.20-0.30 keeps most of the performance.

geometry.comment: voxel_size_mm is the resolution of the whole model. Halving it multiplies memory by ~8. Start coarse.
